summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Menu Items location filter and sync-all-locations feature. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - location filter defaults to Edgewood, sync toggle is checked by default, location change reloads items, edit form opens correctly.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing menu items for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu location filter and sync-all-locations feature fully tested and working. Admin can filter menu items by location (~179 items per location), and when editing with sync enabled, changes propagate to all locations with the same item name.

get_all_menu_items.test: Returns all items (~1611 across all locations)

update_with_sync_all_true.test: Updates ALL locations with same item name
update_with_sync_all_true.details: Verified description change propagated to midtown when editing edgewood item

update_without_sync.test: Only updates the specific item, not other locations
update_without_sync.details: Verified midtown item was NOT updated when sync disabled

public_menu_after_edit.test: Returns updated data after admin edit

location_item_counts.test: Each location has reasonable item counts
location_item_counts.details: All 8 locations have menu items, total >1000

location_filter_dropdown.test: Location filter dropdown present with data-testid='menu-location-filter'

sync_all_toggle.test: Sync all locations checkbox present with data-testid='sync-all-toggle'

apply_edits_text.test: 'Apply edits to all locations' text visible

menu_items_count.test: Header shows correct item count for selected location

location_change_reloads.details: Changed from Edgewood to Midtown, items reloaded

edit_form_opens.test: Edit form opens when pencil icon clicked
edit_form_opens.details: Form shows name, price, description, category, badges, image fields

menu_item_cards.test: Menu items displayed as cards with images, prices, action buttons
menu_item_cards.details: Cards show LOCAL badge, price, edit/delete buttons

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Admin was editing items without location filtering (1611 items from ALL locations), so edits only affected one location's copy
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added location filter (defaults to edgewood-atlanta), sync-all-locations toggle, and backend support for propagating edits
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: PASS - Location filter shows ~179 items per location, sync toggle propagates changes to all locations with same item name
